semiconductor_relevance: High — Hanaki Rubber specializes in high-performance rubber gloves and finger cots specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing and related applications.
summary: Hanaki Rubber Co., Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of high-performance rubber gloves and finger cots tailored for semiconductor manufacturing, electronics, and chemical processing. Their products are designed to protect both workers and sensitive components, ensuring safety and reliability in manufacturing operations.
capabilities: Chemical protective gloves for semiconductor wet processing
Finger cots for electronics and chemical applications
Durable rubber gloves with excellent chemical resistance

regional_presence.Japan: Hanaki Rubber manufactures all products in Japan, ensuring consistent quality and reliable supply.
